name: Ryuujou Yuuren
source: A Japanese painting artist. He's Mashiro's father and Futaai's, Shuka's sister, fiancee. It seems like he had an obsession with "Tsuzuki". He'd been painting only about "Tuzuki" since the death of Futaai.
